title: Bali Luxury Honeymoon: 7 Days in Nusa Dua & Ubud
meta_title: Bali Honeymoon 7 Days: Nusa Dua & Ubud | Blue Diamond Voyage
meta_description: 7-day Bali honeymoon: 6 nights in a Nusa Dua honeymoon suite, the Gates of Heaven, Tanah Lot at sunset, a first scuba dive and a candlelight dinner in Ubud.
price_note: Contact us for a personalised quote for your dates, flights and hotel choice.
hero_alt: Bali temple and rice terraces at sunrise
tagline: Temples at dawn, the ocean at sunset, and a garden dinner for two
intro: A slow, romantic week that pairs a honeymoon suite in Nusa Dua with Bali's most photogenic temples, a sunset at Tanah Lot, your first scuba dive and a private candlelight dinner in an Ubud garden. Every transfer is private, and every day is paced around Bali's traffic and temple timings, so you spend your time together and not in a car.

days.title: Land in Bali and settle into your honeymoon suite
days.summary: Private transfer from Ngurah Rai Airport to Nusa Dua, check-in to the Honeymoon Suite and a slow first evening.
route: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua

rows.label: On landing · Ngurah Rai Airport (DPS)
rows.title: Immigration, the tourist levy and your driver
rows.text: Clear immigration and collect your bags. Your private driver waits in the arrivals hall with a name sign. Up to 60 minutes of waiting is included.
notes: CARE
If your visa or levy is not done online, the counters can add 30 to 60 minutes. Do both before you fly.
MONEY
The Bali tourist levy is IDR 150,000 per person, paid once per trip, by card or QRIS only. No cash.

rows.label: About 30 minutes by private SUV
rows.title: Drive to Nusa Dua by the Bali Mandara toll road
rows.text: The toll road crosses the mangroves and is the quickest way south. Evening traffic on the bypass can stretch it to 45 minutes.

rows.label: From 14:00 · check-in
rows.title: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort · Honeymoon Suite
rows.text: Check in and unpack. Nusa Dua's calm, reef-protected beach is a short drive away, and the resort pools are right outside your room.
notes: MONEY
Use a credit card for the deposit at check-in, never a forex or debit card.

rows.label: Evening
rows.title: First dinner together at the resort
rows.text: Keep the first night easy after the flight.

places: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua
days.note: Ask the front desk tonight for a 04:30 wake-up call and a packed breakfast. Tomorrow's pick-up for East Bali is early, and it is the reason you get the Gates of Heaven before the crowds.

days.title: East Bali: the Gates of Heaven, the water palace and the rice terraces
days.summary: Private photo tour with a guide to Lempuyang, Tirta Gangga, Goa Raja Waterfall and Tegalalang, returning via Ubud.
route: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua
The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua

rows.label: About 04:30 · hotel lobby
rows.title: Private guide and SUV to East Bali
rows.text: Sleep in the car. The early start is what beats the photo queue at Lempuyang.

rows.label: About 07:00 · Lempuyang Temple
rows.title: Pura Lempuyang · the 'Gates of Heaven' with Mount Agung behind
rows.text: Cars park at the main terminal, and a shuttle takes you up to the gate. Your turn for the famous photo comes by queue number.
bullets: The photo queue is often two to four hours, and longer after 09:00.
The ticket office is cash only. Carry small notes.
notes: WEAR
Covered shoulders, and a sarong for everyone, even over trousers. A basic sarong comes with the ticket.
CARE
Women who are menstruating are traditionally asked not to enter temple grounds. Please respect this.

rows.label: About 30 minutes' drive
rows.title: Tirta Gangga Water Palace
rows.text: The former royal water garden of Karangasem. Walk the stepping stones across the koi ponds. About one hour.

rows.label: Midday
rows.title: Lunch on the road in East Bali
rows.text: Your guide stops at a clean local restaurant. Ask for food cooked fresh to your brief.

rows.label: Afternoon
rows.title: Goa Raja Waterfall
rows.text: A cave waterfall in the forest. Wear shoes with grip for the wet steps.

rows.label: Late afternoon · on the way back
rows.title: Tegalalang Rice Terraces
rows.text: Walk the paths along the terraces in the softer evening light.
notes: MONEY
Farmers ask a small cash donation on some paths. The jungle swings are a separate, optional charge.

rows.label: About 18:30
rows.title: Back at the resort
rows.text: About 1 hour 15 minutes from Ubud to Nusa Dua, longer in evening traffic.

days.note: This is the longest day of the week. Pack a sarong and sash, a light jacket for the cool hill at Lempuyang, cash in small notes, and your power bank. Tomorrow starts slowly, on purpose.

days.title: A slow morning, then Tanah Lot at sunset
days.summary: A free morning at the resort, then the 16th-century sea temple of Tanah Lot at sunset.
route: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua
The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua

rows.label: Morning
rows.title: Pools, a late breakfast, or a couples' spa
rows.text: No alarm today. A Balinese massage is the best cure for yesterday's drive.

rows.label: About 15:00 · hotel lobby
rows.title: Private transfer to Tanah Lot
rows.text: About 1 hour 15 minutes up the west coast.

rows.label: About 16:30 · Tanah Lot
rows.title: The sea temple on its rock
rows.text: Walk the cliff path first, then come down to the shore. Watch the sun set behind the temple from the cliff-top cafés.
notes: CARE
Only Hindu worshippers may climb onto the temple rock. At low tide you can walk to its base and receive holy spring water and a blessing.
TIME
Low tide decides how close you can go. We check the tide for your date.

rows.label: About 20:30
rows.title: Back at the resort

days.note: Tanah Lot is busiest in the hour before sunset. Ask your driver to drop you at the main gate and arrange the pick-up point before you walk in, because the car park is large.

days.title: Your first dive: Discover Scuba
days.summary: Discover Scuba Dive for beginners with theory, equipment briefing and an instructor beside you.
route: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua
The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua

rows.label: Morning pick-up
rows.title: Discover Scuba Dive with an English-speaking instructor
rows.text: A short theory lesson and equipment briefing first. Then you dive with your instructor beside you at all times, to see coral, reef fish and, with luck, a sea turtle.
bullets: We choose the dive site for your dates and the sea conditions.
Nusa Dua and Tanjung Benoa are closest. Nusa Penida or Amed make a day trip.
notes: CARE
Divers must be in good health. Tell us about any medical condition, pregnancy or recent surgery before booking.
TIP
This is why the dive sits early in the week: no flying within 18 hours of diving.

rows.label: Afternoon
rows.title: Rest by the pool

days.note: Bring reef-safe sunscreen and a change of clothes. Contact lenses are fine under the mask, but carry spare glasses.

days.title: Ubud's culture by day, a candlelight dinner by night
days.summary: Ubud Monkey Forest, Ubud Art Market and Ubud Palace, then a private two-hour candlelight dinner in a garden.
route: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua
The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua

rows.label: Late morning · private transfer
rows.title: Drive to Ubud, Bali's cultural heart
rows.text: About 1 hour 15 minutes from Nusa Dua.

rows.label: About 12:00
rows.title: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary
rows.text: Shaded jungle paths, mossy temples and hundreds of long-tailed macaques. About one hour. Entry is paid at the gate.
notes: CARE
Put sunglasses, earrings, phones and snacks out of sight. The macaques are quick, and they bite when grabbed.

rows.label: Afternoon
rows.title: Ubud Art Market and Ubud Palace
rows.text: The market and the palace face each other on Jalan Raya Ubud.
notes: BUY
Sarongs, silver, woven baskets and wood carving. Bargaining is expected, and starting at half the asking price is normal.

rows.label: From 18:00 · two hours
rows.title: Private candlelight dinner for two in an Ubud garden
rows.text: A table set for two among the plants and lanterns. Tell us your menu brief when you book, and the kitchen prepares it.

rows.label: After dinner
rows.title: Private transfer back to Nusa Dua
rows.text: About 1 hour 15 minutes at night.

days.note: Ubud is the best place in Bali to see a Legong dance. Ask us if you would like seats before your dinner, and we will fit the timings around it.

days.title: A day for the two of you, or Uluwatu's fire dance
days.summary: A free day at the resort, with an optional sunset at Uluwatu Temple, the Kecak fire dance and dinner on Jimbaran Bay.
route: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua
The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua

rows.label: All day
rows.title: Beach, spa and resort
rows.text: Nusa Dua Beach is calm, clean and good for swimming.

rows.label: Optional · leave about 16:00
rows.title: Uluwatu Temple on its clifftop
rows.text: The temple stands on a cliff above the Indian Ocean. Open about 07:00 to 19:00.
notes: MONEY
Temple entry is about IDR 60,000 per adult. Cash or QRIS only, no international cards.
CARE
Uluwatu's monkeys snatch glasses and phones too. Hold on to them on the cliff path.

rows.label: Optional · around sunset
rows.title: Kecak fire dance
rows.text: A circle of chanting voices tells the Ramayana as the sun goes down behind the dancers.
notes: MONEY
About IDR 150,000 per adult at the box office. We pre-book seats to save the queue.
TIME
Arrive by about 16:30 to 17:00 for a good seat.

rows.label: Optional · after the dance
rows.title: Dinner on the sand at Jimbaran Bay
rows.text: Tables on the beach and the lights of the fishing boats. Vegetarian dishes are cooked to order.
meal: Half board at the resort, or pay at Jimbaran

days.note: Tonight, pack and put your passports, phones and chargers in your hand luggage. Tell the front desk your pick-up time for tomorrow.

days.title: Breakfast, check-out and the flight home
days.summary: Breakfast, check-out and a private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport about 3 hours before the flight.
route: The Crystal Luxury Bay Resort Nusa Dua

rows.label: Morning
rows.title: Last breakfast and a last swim
rows.text: Ask for a late check-out if your flight is in the evening. It depends on the day's occupancy.

rows.label: About 4 hours before your flight
rows.title: Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport
rows.text: Your driver meets you in the lobby. Drivers wait at hotels for about ten minutes, so please be ready.
notes: TIME
Allow extra time on Friday and weekend evenings, when the toll road and the bypass are at their busiest.

days.note: Keep your levy voucher and passport handy until you board. Selamat jalan, and come back soon.

entry_notes: Apply for the e-VOA on the official Indonesian immigration site before you fly. It skips the visa queue at the airport.
Pay the tourist levy on the official Love Bali site. The QR voucher arrives by email. Keep it on your phone.

Phone and internet: a Bali eSIM bought before you fly works the moment you land and keeps your own number for WhatsApp. A local tourist SIM at the airport is cheaper but needs your passport. Home-carrier roaming is simplest and dearest.

good_to_know.title: Hotel deposit
good_to_know.text: Use a credit card for the deposit or pre-authorisation at check-in, never a forex or debit card. Forex cards cannot hold funds, hotels often refuse them, and a credit card hold is released faster and more safely.

good_to_know.title: Cards and cash
good_to_know.text: On card machines, always choose to pay in Indonesian rupiah, never in INR or USD. Carry cash for temples, donations, markets and small cafés: about IDR 500,000 a day for two is plenty. Exchange at authorised money changers or use bank ATMs inside malls and hotels.

good_to_know.title: Tipping
good_to_know.text: Many restaurants add a 5 to 10% service charge. Round up for drivers and guides at the end of a good day. It is appreciated, not expected.

good_to_know.title: Temple dress code
good_to_know.text: Covered shoulders and knees, with a sarong and a sash at the waist. Do not stand higher than the priest, step over offerings on the ground or point your feet at shrines.

good_to_know.title: Monkeys and pickpockets
good_to_know.text: Hold on to glasses, phones and earrings at Uluwatu and the Ubud Monkey Forest. Bag snatching from scooters happens in Kuta and Seminyak: walk with your bag on the side away from the road.

good_to_know.title: Plugs, water and meal times
good_to_know.text: Plugs are the two round-pin type C and F, at 230 volts. Indian three-pin plugs need an adaptor. Drink bottled or filtered water only, including for brushing teeth. Dinner runs from about 18:00 to 22:00.

good_to_know.title: Days to avoid
good_to_know.text: Nyepi, Bali's Day of Silence, closes the airport, roads and beaches for 24 hours. In 2027 it falls on Monday 8 March. We plan around it.

dining_intro: Your resort serves breakfast and dinner, and we send your dietary brief to the kitchen before you arrive. For the meals out, these are places where you can order to a vegetarian or Jain brief.

dining.name: Queens of India, Nusa Dua
dining.address: Jalan Pratama No. 65B, Benoa, Nusa Dua
dining.order: Dal tadka with a jeera tadka, paneer tikka, jeera rice and tandoori roti. For Jain, ask for no onion, garlic, ginger or potato, cooked fresh.

dining.name: Zest Ubud
dining.order: Bowls, salads and wood-fired dishes. Ask for them without garlic and onion if you eat Jain.

dining_avoid: Most Balinese food starts with a spice paste of shallot, garlic and ginger, and sambal and many sauces contain shrimp paste (terasi). Nasi goreng, mie goreng and gado-gado are not Jain. Always ask for food cooked fresh: sauces are made ahead.
food_card: Kami vegetarian ketat (Jain). Kami tidak makan daging, ayam, ikan, makanan laut, atau telur. Kami juga tidak makan bawang merah, bawang putih, bawang bombay, jahe, kentang, wortel, ubi, bit, jamur, atau umbi lainnya. Tanpa terasi dan tanpa saus ikan. Mohon dimasak segar. Terima kasih.
Jain khana: pyaz, lahsun, adrak, aloo, gajar nahi. Taaza banaiye, please.
best_time: April to October is the dry season, with sunny days and calm seas for the beaches, temples and diving. November to March is the wet season: greener and quieter, with short tropical showers, usually in the afternoon. Avoid Nyepi, Bali's Day of Silence in March, when the airport and roads close for 24 hours.
seasons: About 30° / 23°, sunny, calm seas. The best months for diving and East Bali views of Mount Agung.
Book hotels and the Lempuyang tour early. Queues are longest.
About 31° / 24°, humid, short afternoon showers. Greener, quieter and better hotel availability.

faqs.q: When is the best time for a honeymoon in Bali?
faqs.a: April to October is the dry season, with sunny days and calm seas, ideal for beaches, temples and diving. November to March is the wet season. It's greener and quieter, with short tropical showers, usually in the afternoon.

faqs.q: Is Nusa Dua or Ubud better for a honeymoon?
faqs.a: Nusa Dua offers calm beaches and resorts, while Ubud offers jungle villas, rice terraces and culture. This itinerary bases you in Nusa Dua and takes you to Ubud for a day and a romantic dinner. We can also split your stay, for example 3 nights in Ubud and 3 in Nusa Dua.

faqs.q: Do Indian citizens need a visa for Bali?
faqs.a: Indian passport holders can get a visa on arrival or apply online for an e-VOA before travel, for about IDR 500,000 per person, valid for 30 days. Your passport needs at least 6 months' validity. Every foreign visitor also pays the Bali tourist levy of IDR 150,000 once per trip.
Yes. Every Blue Diamond Voyage itinerary is a starting point. We change hotels, add Nusa Penida, the Gili Islands or a private pool villa, and plan flights from your city.

faqs.q: Is vegetarian or Jain food available in Bali?
faqs.a: Yes. Bali has many vegetarian and Indian restaurants, especially in Ubud, Seminyak and Nusa Dua. Tell us your dietary needs and we inform the resort in advance and choose restaurants for you. We also give you a food card in Bahasa Indonesia to show the waiter.

faqs.q: How long is the drive to the Gates of Heaven?
faqs.a: About 2.5 to 3 hours each way from Nusa Dua. That is why the East Bali day starts at about 04:30: you reach Lempuyang near opening time, before the photo queue grows.
